trigger: All 113 nonaccepted primary outcomes, including 9 solver-infeasible outcomes. The original 704 attempts remain unchanged.
formulation: Same QSDP in an explicit real Hermitian basis and PSD realification. Full-block dual adjoint Z=D11+D22+j(D21-D12), independently reviewed.
acceptance_gates: Exactly the same VALIDATION-PLAN.json gates; no loosening

attempts.when: First refinement has neither a numerically accepted solution nor solver status infeasible

selection: Keep primary if already accepted; otherwise select first refinement accepted by all unchanged residual/factor gates. Preserve and report every attempt and solver status. If no accepted solution, report confirmed solver-infeasible versus unresolved numerical failure separately.
runtime: Primary same-budget timings remain the method comparison. Refinement timing is reported separately and is not a browser latency measure.
diagnostic_warning: Native complex-dual extraction can be asymmetric and fail PSD/stationarity gates despite a valid underlying real-cone certificate. A rejection on those diagnostics alone is not proof the primal optimum is wrong.
